paper_id: Zhou et al. - 2025 - QUIDS Quality-informed Incentive-driven Multi-agent Dispatching System for Mobile Crowdsensing
title: QUIDS: Quality-informed Incentive-driven Multi-agent Dispatching System for Mobile Crowdsensing
venue: IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing (in review)
motivation: 非专用车辆感知覆盖不均、传感器可靠性不确定、覆盖与可靠性存在此消彼长的矛盾
problem_framing: 将覆盖与可靠性的耦合问题建模为ASQ指标的最大化优化问题，约束为预算限制
key_insight: 多个低可靠性传感器的读数通过聚合可以补偿个体偏差，协同推理可同时提升数据可靠性和调度效率
method_signature: ASQ指标 + 协同推理 + 差异化激励的车辆调度算法
evaluation_criteria: ASQ提升38%、地图重构误差降低39-74%、覆盖率与可靠性联合优化效果
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: truth discovery假设同模态数据，对跨模态数据融合场景不适用；依赖准确的轨迹预测
evidence_for_taste: neglecting sensing reliability may lead to unreliable data
does not distinguish between dynamic errors and constant biases
thinking_moves: 用数据聚合思路解决低质量传感器偏差问题
将感知可靠性与覆盖率解耦为统一的ASQ指标
引入bias term扩展truth discovery框架处理系统性误差
激励设计结合机会成本和风险补偿扩大可行域
cites_own_work: Quest: Quality-informed multi-agent dispatching system (INFOCOM 2024) - extended version
